parametrized_description: Jacob has TotalInvestment to invest between a clothing company and a tech company. The clothing investment must be at least ClothingToTechRatio times the tech investment. The tech investment cannot exceed MaxTechInvestment. Clothing earns ClothingInterestRate and tech earns TechInterestRate. Maximize total profit.

TotalInvestment.description: Total amount of money available to invest

ClothingToTechRatio.description: Minimum ratio of clothing investment to tech investment

MaxTechInvestment.description: Maximum investment allowed in tech company

ClothingInterestRate.description: Interest rate earned from clothing company investment

TechInterestRate.description: Interest rate earned from tech company investment

constraints.description: Total investment must not exceed TotalInvestment.
Clothing investment must be at least ClothingToTechRatio times tech investment.
Tech investment must not exceed MaxTechInvestment.

objective.description: Maximize total profit from both investments.
